sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Get your money’s worth.
sentences.ipa: /ɡˌɛt jɔː mˈʌniz wˈɜːθ./
sentences.meaning: 获取你的钱的价值。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: understand how to manage money well.
sentences.ipa: /ˌʌndəstˈand hˌaʊ tə mˈanɪʤ mˈʌni wˈɛl./
sentences.meaning: 理解如何妥善管理资金。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Money plays an important role in our lives.
sentences.ipa: /mˈʌni plˈeɪz ɐn ɪmpˈɔːtᵊnt ɹˈəʊl ɪn ˌaʊə lˈaɪvz./
sentences.meaning: 金钱对我们的生活起着重要作用。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s learn about money and how to manage it well.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɛts lˈɜːn əbˈaʊt mˈʌni and hˌaʊ tə mˈanɪʤ ɪt wˈɛl./
sentences.meaning: 如何妥善管理资金。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A The Class 1, Grade 7 students are learning about money around the world.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ ðə klˈɑːs wˈʌn, ɡɹˈeɪd sˈɛvᵊn stjˈuːdnts ɑː lˈɜːnɪŋ əbˈaʊt mˈʌni əɹˈaʊnd ðə wˈɜːld./
sentences.meaning: 一年级7年级的学生在世界各地学习钱。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Look at the pictures below.
sentences.ipa: /lˈʊk at ðə pˈɪkʧəz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 看下面的图片

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Match each country and its money with the correct gift.
sentences.ipa: /mˈaʧ ˈiːʧ kˈʌntɹi and ɪts mˈʌni wɪð ðə kəɹˈɛkt ɡˈɪft./
sentences.meaning: 以正确的天赋匹配每个国家及其资金。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Simon and Millie are talking about the gifts above.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː and mˈɪli ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðə ɡˈɪfts əbˈʌv./
sentences.meaning: B西蒙和米莉在谈论上面的礼物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and talk about popular gifts from different countries.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn pˈɛːz and tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt pˈɒpjʊlə ɡˈɪfts fɹɒm dˈɪfəɹənt kˈʌntɹiz./
sentences.meaning: 成对工作，谈论不同国家的流行礼物。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn bɪlˈəʊ az ɐ mˈɒdᵊl./
sentences.meaning: 以下面的对话为示范。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Which gift do you like, Millie?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɪʧ ɡˈɪft dˈuː juː lˈaɪk, mˈɪli?/
sentences.meaning: 你喜欢哪份礼物，米莉？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I love those Russian dolls.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv ðəʊz ɹˈʌʃᵊn dˈɒlz./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢那些俄国娃娃

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: What’s special about them?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒts spˈɛʃl əbˈaʊt ðˌɛm?/
sentences.meaning: 他们有什么特别？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: They’re a set of dolls in different sizes. Usually they come one inside another, from the biggest to the smallest. They’re colourful and full of surprises. What about you, Simon?
sentences.ipa: /ðˌɛː ɐ sˈɛt ɒv dˈɒlz ɪn dˈɪfəɹənt sˈaɪzɪz. jˈuːʒʊəli ðeɪ kˈʌm wˈʌn ˌɪnsˈaɪd ənˈʌðə, fɹɒm ðə bˈɪɡɪst tə ðə smˈɔːlɪst. ðˌɛː kˈʌləfʊl and fˈʊl ɒv səpɹˈaɪzɪz. wˌɒt əbˈaʊt juː, sˈaɪmən?/
sentences.meaning: 它们是一套大小不一的娃娃。 通常它们从最大的到最小的，它们相互内在。它们色彩鲜艳，充满惊喜。你呢，西蒙？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I love baseball caps. Players wear them to protect their eyes from the sun, and they’re also a kind of fashion.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv bˈeɪsbɔːl kˈaps. plˈeɪəz wˈɛː ðˌɛm tə pɹətˈɛkt ðɛː ˈaɪz fɹɒm ðə sˈʌn, and ðɛː ˈɔːlsəʊ ɐ kˈaɪnd ɒv fˈaʃᵊn./
sentences.meaning: ▁我喜欢棒球帽，玩家戴着棒球帽是为了保护眼睛免受太阳的侵袭，他们也是时尚的一种。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C What other countries’ money do you know?
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː wˌɒt ˈʌðə kˈʌntɹiz” mˈʌni dˈuː juː nˈəʊ?/
sentences.meaning: C. 其他国家的资金？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon is talking to his mum about how his family manages their money.
sentences.ipa: /ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɪz mˈʌm əbˈaʊt hˌaʊ hɪz fˈamɪli mˈanɪʤɪz ðɛː mˈʌni./
sentences.meaning: 西蒙在和他妈妈说 他的家人怎么管理他们的钱

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read their conversation.
sentences.ipa: /ɹˈiːd ðɛː kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn./
sentences.meaning: 看他们的谈话

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪfˈɔː ɹˈiːdɪŋ, θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Does your family make plans for using money?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn dˈʌz jɔː fˈamɪli mˌeɪk plˈanz fɔː jˈuːzɪŋ mˈʌni?/
sentences.meaning: 1，你的家人是否计划用钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What do you think your family spends the most money on every year?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk jɔː fˈamɪli spˈɛndz ðə mˈəʊst mˈʌni ˌɒn ˈɛvəɹi jˈɪə?/
sentences.meaning: 2 你觉得你的家人每年花的钱最多吗？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: There’s a new mall across the street. Let’s go shopping.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌɛːz ɐ njˈuː mˈal əkɹˈɒs ðə stɹˈiːt. lˈɛts ɡˌəʊ ʃˈɒpɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 街对面有个新商场。 让我们去购物吧。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: OK. Can I have a new pair of sports shoes?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ. kˌan ˌaɪ hav ɐ njˈuː pˈɛː ɒv spˈɔːts ʃˈuːz?/
sentences.meaning: 好，我们走吧 我能换双运动鞋吗？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Of course. And we also need a new computer.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒv kˈɔːs. ˌand wiː ˈɔːlsəʊ nˈiːd ɐ njˈuː kəmpjˈuːtə./
sentences.meaning: 当然 我们还需要一台新的电脑。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: That will cost a lot of money.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈat wɪl kˈɒst ɐ lˈɒt ɒv mˈʌni./
sentences.meaning: 这需要很多钱。

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Don’t worry. Your dad and I manage money well. We make a budget every year.
sentences.ipa: /dˈəʊnt wˈʌɹi. jˌɔː dˈad and ˌaɪ mˈanɪʤ mˈʌni wˈɛl. wˌiː mˌeɪk ɐ bˈʌʤɪt ˈɛvəɹi jˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 别担心， 你爸爸和我管理好钱。 我们每年做一个预算。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: What’s in the budget?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒts ɪn ðə bˈʌʤɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 预算是多少？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Well … we need to cover your education first. Then we have to pay for our flat, car, food and other daily needs every month. All these cost about 50 per cent of our budget.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɛl … wiː nˈiːd tə kˈʌvə jɔː ˌɛdjʊkˈeɪʃᵊn fˈɜːst. ðˈɛn wiː hav tə pˈeɪ fɔː ˌaʊə flˈat, kˈɑː, fˈuːd and ˈʌðə dˈeɪli nˈiːdz ˈɛvəɹi mˈʌnθ. ˈɔːl ðiːz kˈɒst əbˈaʊt fˈɪfti pɜː sˈɛnt ɒv ˌaʊə bˈʌʤɪt./
sentences.meaning: 嗯... 我们需要先照顾你的教育。 然后，我们每月必须支付我们的公寓、汽车、食品和其他日常需求。 所有这些费用约占我们预算的50%。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Where does the other half go?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɛː dˈʌz ði ˈʌðə hˈɑːf ɡˌəʊ?/
sentences.meaning: 另一半会去哪？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: We spend about 30 per cent on special things.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː spˈɛnd əbˈaʊt θˈɜːti pɜː sˈɛnt ˌɒn spˈɛʃl θˈɪŋz./
sentences.meaning: 我们花费大约30%用于特殊事务。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Like what?
sentences.ipa: /lˈaɪk wˌɒt?/
sentences.meaning: 比如说？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Like taking holidays. Holidays can be expensive.
sentences.ipa: /lˈaɪk tˈeɪkɪŋ hˈɒlɪdeɪz. hˈɒlɪdeɪz kan biː ɪkspˈɛnsɪv./
sentences.meaning: 就像休假一样 假日可能很贵。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: Do we save any money?
sentences.ipa: /dˈuː wiː sˈeɪv ˈɛni mˈʌni?/
sentences.meaning: 我们要省点钱吗？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Of course. We leave about 20 per cent in our bank account. It’s a good idea to save for a rainy day.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒv kˈɔːs. wˌiː lˈiːv əbˈaʊt twˈɛnti pɜː sˈɛnt ɪn ˌaʊə bˈaŋk əkˈaʊnt. ˌɪts ɐ ɡˈʊd aɪdˈɪə tə sˈeɪv fɔː ɐ ɹˈeɪni dˈeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 当然 我们把20%左右留在我们的银行账户里。 给雨天留点时间是个好主意。

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: I see.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ sˈiː./
sentences.meaning: 原来如此

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Here is a pie chart about Simon’s family budget.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ hˈɪə ɪz ɐ pˈaɪ ʧˈɑːt əbˈaʊt s fˈamɪli bˈʌʤɪt./
sentences.meaning: 以下是关于西蒙家庭预算的馅饼图。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Label the parts of the chart about his family budget, and write the correct percentage next to each label.
sentences.ipa: /lˈeɪbᵊl ðə pˈɑːts ɒv ðə ʧˈɑːt əbˈaʊt hɪz fˈamɪli bˈʌʤɪt, and ɹˈaɪt ðə kəɹˈɛkt pəsˈɛntɪʤ nˈɛkst tʊ ˈiːʧ lˈeɪbᵊl./
sentences.meaning: 标注图表中他家庭预算的部分，并在每个标签旁边写正确的百分比。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then fill in the details in the chart.
sentences.ipa: /ðˈɛn fˈɪl ˈɪn ðə dˈiːteɪlz ɪn ðə ʧˈɑːt./
sentences.meaning: 然后填写图表中的细节。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Read the conversation again and answer the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː ɹˈiːd ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn əɡˈɛn and ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: B再读一次谈话，回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What does Simon’s mum need to buy in the new mall?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt dˈʌz s mˈʌm nˈiːd tə bˈaɪ ɪn ðə njˈuː mˈal?/
sentences.meaning: 1 Simon的妈妈在新商场需要买什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 How does Simon’s family manage their money?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː hˌaʊ dˈʌz s fˈamɪli mˈanɪʤ ðɛː mˈʌni?/
sentences.meaning: 2 Simon的家人如何管理他们的钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 What comes first in Simon’s family budget?
sentences.ipa: /θɹˈiː wˌɒt kˈʌmz fˈɜːst ɪn s fˈamɪli bˈʌʤɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 3 西蒙的家庭预算首先是什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 What is an example of a special thing in Simon’s family?
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː wˌɒt ɪz ɐn ɪɡzˈɑːmpᵊl ɒv ɐ spˈɛʃl θˈɪŋ ɪn s fˈamɪli?/
sentences.meaning: 4 西蒙家有什么特殊之处？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 What does Simon’s mum mean by saying “to save for a rainy day”?
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv wˌɒt dˈʌz s mˈʌm mˈiːn baɪ sˈeɪɪŋ “tə sˈeɪv fɔː ɐ ɹˈeɪni dˈeɪ”?/
sentences.meaning: 5 Simon的妈妈说“为雨天省钱”是什么意思？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Simon is reading his friend John’s blog post about his family budget.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː ɪz ɹˈiːdɪŋ hɪz fɹˈɛnd ʤˈɒnz blˈɒɡ pˈəʊst əbˈaʊt hɪz fˈamɪli bˈʌʤɪt./
sentences.meaning: C Simon正在阅读他朋友John的博客文章，

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete the blog post with the correct forms of the words and phrases in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðə blˈɒɡ pˈəʊst wɪð ðə kəɹˈɛkt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə wˈɜːdz and fɹˈeɪzɪz ɪn ðə bˈɒks bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在博客文章中填写以下框中文字和短语的正确形式。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Money matters in every family.
sentences.ipa: /mˈʌni mˈatəz ɪn ˈɛvəɹi fˈamɪli./
sentences.meaning: 金钱在每个家庭都很重要。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: money well.
sentences.ipa: /mˈʌni wˈɛl./
sentences.meaning: 钱好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: things like our house and car.
sentences.ipa: /θˈɪŋz lˈaɪk ˌaʊə hˈaʊs and kˈɑː./
sentences.meaning: 就像我们的房子和车

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: budget.
sentences.ipa: /bˈʌʤɪt./
sentences.meaning: 预算。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: day”.
sentences.ipa: /dˈeɪ”./
sentences.meaning: 中文无改动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I think that is a great idea.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ θˈɪŋk ðˈat ɪz ɐ ɡɹˈeɪt aɪdˈɪə./
sentences.meaning: 我认为这是一个好主意。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: D 考虑以下问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Share your answers with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˈɛː jɔː ˈɑːnsəz wɪð jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 与同学分享答案。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What do you think of Simon’s family budget?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk ɒv s fˈamɪli bˈʌʤɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 1 你觉得西蒙的家庭预算怎么样？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 Make a budget for your family.
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː mˌeɪk ɐ bˈʌʤɪt fɔː jɔː fˈamɪli./
sentences.meaning: 2，为家庭编制预算。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What is in your budget?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt ɪz ɪn jɔː bˈʌʤɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 你的预算是多少？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Do you think it is important to make a budget?
sentences.ipa: /θɹˈiː dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk ɪt ɪz ɪmpˈɔːtᵊnt tə mˌeɪk ɐ bˈʌʤɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 3，你认为编制预算很重要吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Why or why not?
sentences.ipa: /wˌaɪ ɔː wˌaɪ nˌɒt?/
sentences.meaning: 为什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon is talking to his mum before they go to the supermarket.
sentences.ipa: /ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɪz mˈʌm bɪfˈɔː ðeɪ ɡˌəʊ tə ðə sˈuːpəmˌɑːkɪt./
sentences.meaning: 在他们去超市之前 Simon正在和他妈妈说话

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here is their conversation.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə ɪz ðɛː kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn./
sentences.meaning: 这是他们的对话。

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Let’s go to the supermarket. We need some meat,... and also some fruit and vegetables.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɛts ɡˌəʊ tə ðə sˈuːpəmˌɑːkɪt. wˌiː nˈiːd sˌʌm mˈiːt,... and ˈɔːlsəʊ sˌʌm fɹˈuːt and vˈɛʤɪtəbᵊlz./
sentences.meaning: 让我们去超市吧。 我们需要一些肉 还有水果和蔬菜

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We can use some in questions when we are making offers or requests.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː kan jˈuːz sˌʌm ɪn kwˈɛsʧᵊnz wˌɛn wiː ɑː mˈeɪkɪŋ ˈɒfəz ɔː ɹɪkwˈɛsts./
sentences.meaning: 当我们提出提议或请求时，我们可以在问题中使用一些。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use it when we expect the answer to be “yes”.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz ɪt wˌɛn wiː ɪkspˈɛkt ði ˈɑːnsə tə biː “jˈɛs”./
sentences.meaning: 当我们期望答案是“是”时，我们就使用它。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Would you like some tea?
sentences.ipa: /wˌʊd juː lˈaɪk sˌʌm tˈiː?/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Can I have some oranges?
sentences.ipa: /kˌan ˌaɪ hav sˌʌm ˈɒɹɪnʤɪz?/
sentences.meaning: 能给我一些橙子吗？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: OK, Mum. Please buy some bananas. They’re my favourite.
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ, mˈʌm. plˈiːz bˈaɪ sˌʌm bənˈɑːnəz. ðˌɛː maɪ fˈeɪvəɹɪt./
sentences.meaning: ▁好的▁妈妈▁请买些香蕉▁这是我最喜欢的

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: OK. Do we need any other things?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ. dˈuː wiː nˈiːd ˈɛni ˈʌðə θˈɪŋz?/
sentences.meaning: 好，我们走吧 我们还需要别的吗？

sentences.speaker: simon
sentences.text: We don’t have any drinks. Can we buy some, Mum?
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː dˈəʊnt hav ˈɛni dɹˈɪŋks. kˌan wiː bˈaɪ sˌʌm, mˈʌm?/
sentences.meaning: ▁我们没有喝的，我们能买点吗，妈妈？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Sure.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˈʊə./
sentences.meaning: ▁当然

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use some or any to talk about the amount of something.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz sˌʌm ɔː ˈɛni tə tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt ði əmˈaʊnt ɒv sˈʌmθɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我们用一些或任何 谈论的东西的数量。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A1 Millie is talking to her mum about money management.
sentences.ipa: /ˈeɪ wˈʌn mˈɪli ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə hɜː mˈʌm əbˈaʊt mˈʌni mˈanɪʤmᵊnt./
sentences.meaning: A1米莉跟她妈妈谈钱管理。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their conversation with some and any.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðɛː kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn wɪð sˌʌm and ˈɛni./
sentences.meaning: 完成他们与一些人和任何人的对话。

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: Sure. What do you want to do with your money?
sentences.ipa: /ʃˈʊə. wˌɒt dˈuː juː wˈɒnt tə dˈuː wɪð jɔː mˈʌni?/
sentences.meaning: 当然 你想拿钱做什么？

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: OK. What do you want to buy?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ. wˌɒt dˈuː juː wˈɒnt tə bˈaɪ?/
sentences.meaning: 好，我们走吧 你想买什么？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Maybe I can save it.
sentences.ipa: /mˈeɪbiː ˌaɪ kan sˈeɪv ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 也许我可以保存它。

sentences.speaker: mum
sentences.text: You can put it in the bank. I can help you.
sentences.ipa: /jˌuː kan pˌʊt ɪt ɪn ðə bˈaŋk. ˌaɪ kan hˈɛlp juː./
sentences.meaning: 你可以把它放在银行。 我可以帮你

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: Great! Thanks, Mum! A2 Talk with your partner about what you usually do with your pocket money, using some and any.
sentences.ipa: /ɡɹˈeɪt! θˈaŋks, mˈʌm! ˈeɪ tˈuː tˈɔːk wɪð jɔː pˈɑːtnə əbˈaʊt wˌɒt juː jˈuːʒʊəli dˈuː wɪð jɔː pˈɒkɪt mˈʌni, jˈuːzɪŋ sˌʌm and ˈɛni./
sentences.meaning: ▁谢谢，妈妈，A2跟你的搭档谈谈▁你通常拿零用钱做什么，用什么的

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Simon and his mum are back from shopping.
sentences.ipa: /and hɪz mˈʌm ɑː bˈak fɹɒm ʃˈɒpɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 西蒙和他的妈妈从购物回来。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s see what they got from the supermarket.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɛts sˈiː wˌɒt ðeɪ ɡɒt fɹɒm ðə sˈuːpəmˌɑːkɪt./
sentences.meaning: 让我们看看他们从超市得到了什么。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /ˌɒn ðə tˈeɪbᵊl./
sentences.meaning: {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}就放在桌子上 {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我还没说

sentences.text: No, there isn’t.
sentences.ipa: /nˈəʊ, ðɛː ɪz./
sentences.meaning: 没有。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: on the table?
sentences.ipa: /ˌɒn ðə tˈeɪbᵊl?/
sentences.meaning: 在桌子上吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yes, there are.
sentences.ipa: /jˈɛs, ðɛː ɑː./
sentences.meaning: 是的，还有。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: No, there aren’t.
sentences.ipa: /nˈəʊ, ðɛː ɑː./
sentences.meaning: 没有。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use there be to show that something exists.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz ðɛː biː tə ʃˈəʊ ðat sˈʌmθɪŋ ɪɡzˈɪsts./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B1 Millie is writing about shops around her school.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː wˈʌn mˈɪli ɪz ɹˈaɪtɪŋ əbˈaʊt ʃˈɒps əɹˈaʊnd hɜː skˈuːl./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Help her complete her article with the correct forms of there be.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɛlp hɜː kəmplˈiːt hɜː ˈɑːtɪkᵊl wɪð ðə kəɹˈɛkt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðɛː bˈiː./
sentences.meaning: 帮助她用正确的形式完成她的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: There are some shops around my school.
sentences.ipa: /ðˌɛː ɑː sˌʌm ʃˈɒps əɹˈaʊnd maɪ skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 我学校附近有些商店

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: in it.
sentences.ipa: /ɪn ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 进去吧

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Sometimes we go there after school.
sentences.ipa: /sˈʌmtaɪmz wiː ɡˌəʊ ðɛː ˈɑːftə skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 有时放学后去那儿

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: and some other nice things too.
sentences.ipa: /and sˌʌm ˈʌðə nˈaɪs θˈɪŋz tˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 还有其他好东西

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: our friends.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaʊə fɹˈɛndz./
sentences.meaning: 我们的朋友。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: a supermarket.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ sˈuːpəmˌɑːkɪt./
sentences.meaning: 一个超市。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: snacks in it.
sentences.ipa: /snˈaks ɪn ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 里面有点心

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B2 Talk with your partner about things in shops or supermarkets around your home or school, using there be, some and any.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː tˈuː tˈɔːk wɪð jɔː pˈɑːtnə əbˈaʊt θˈɪŋz ɪn ʃˈɒps ɔː sˈuːpəmˌɑːkɪts əɹˈaʊnd jɔː hˈəʊm ɔː skˈuːl, jˈuːzɪŋ ðɛː bˈiː, sˌʌm and ˈɛni./
sentences.meaning: B2 跟你的搭档谈谈你家或学校周围的商店或超市里的东西 利用这些东西，有些和任何的

sentences.meaning: 一些和谐的团体在词尾。

sentences.meaning: 1，小面店清净明亮。

sentences.text: 2 My little cousin likes pretty flowers.

sentences.meaning: 我表妹喜欢漂亮的花

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 The price of those pencils is pretty high.
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː ðə pɹˈaɪs ɒv ðəʊz pˈɛnsᵊlz ɪz pɹˈɪti hˈaɪ./
sentences.meaning: 4 这些铅笔的价格相当高。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 My uncle is quite smart with his money.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv mˌaɪ ˈʌŋkᵊl ɪz kwˈaɪt smˈɑːt wɪð hɪz mˈʌni./

sentences.meaning: 一个丹尼尔想了解历史上不同种类的金钱。

sentences.ipa: /jˌuː ɡˈɪv mˌiː tˈuː fˈɪʃ./
sentences.meaning: 你给我两条鱼。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: OK?
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ?/
sentences.meaning: ▁好吗？

sentences.ipa: /hˈɪəz θˈɜːti jʊˈɑːn fɔː ðə bˈʊk./
sentences.meaning: 此书共30元人民币。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Thanks.
sentences.ipa: /θˈaŋks./
sentences.meaning: ▁谢谢。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here you are.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə juː ɑː./
sentences.meaning: 给你

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: OK!
sentences.ipa: /ˌəʊkˈeɪ!/

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: That's a deal!
sentences.ipa: /ðˈats ɐ dˈiːl!/
sentences.meaning: 说定了！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I can buy a computer online.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ kan bˈaɪ ɐ kəmpjˈuːtə ɒnlˈaɪn./
sentences.meaning: 我可以在网上买台电脑。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: That's very easy!
sentences.ipa: /ðˈats vˈɛɹi ˈiːzi!/
sentences.meaning: 这很简单！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: When reading pictures, look closely at the details in the image and read the text in the speech bubbles to better understand the message.

sentences.meaning: 在阅读图片时，仔细查看图像中的细节，并在语音泡沫中阅读文本，以更好地理解信息。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: How much is this bag of rice?
sentences.ipa: /hˌaʊ mˈʌʧ ɪz ðɪs bˈaɡ ɒv ɹˈaɪs?/
sentences.meaning: 这袋米多少钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 45 coins.
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔːti fˈaɪv kˈɔɪnz./
sentences.meaning: 45枚硬币。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 How many ways to pay are there in the pictures?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn hˌaʊ mˈɛni wˈeɪz tə pˈeɪ ɑː ðɛː ɪn ðə pˈɪkʧəz?/
sentences.meaning: 1 图片中有多少支付方式？。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What other kinds of money do you know about?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt ˈʌðə kˈaɪndz ɒv mˈʌni dˈuː juː nˈəʊ əbˈaʊt?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你知道什么其他种类的钱？

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /bˈiː dˈanjəl ɪz tˈɔːkɪŋ tə mˈɪli əbˈaʊt ɐ mˈʌni ʃˈəʊ at sˈʌnʃaɪn mjuːzˈiːəm./
sentences.meaning: B丹尼尔在和米莉谈阳光博物馆的金钱展。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Listen to their conversation and complete the table below.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɪsᵊn tə ðɛː kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn and kəmplˈiːt ðə tˈeɪbᵊl bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 听他们的谈话，然后填写下表。

sentences.text: C Daniel and Millie are talking about lucky money.

sentences.meaning: C丹尼尔和米莉在谈幸运钱

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and talk about the topic.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn pˈɛːz and tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt ðə tˈɒpɪk./
sentences.meaning: 成对地工作，谈论这个话题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.

sentences.text: Do you usually get lucky money at the Spring Festival?
sentences.ipa: /dˈuː juː jˈuːʒʊəli ɡɛt lˈʌki mˈʌni at ðə spɹˈɪŋ fˈɛstɪvᵊl?/
